confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Rio pricing; no live menus, booking pages or listings were checked. Restaurant and bar anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors vary widely by neighborhood, season and booking channel, so they are the least certain. The FX value comes from web-search summaries of the RBA exchange-rate page for the 14 October 2026 4 pm rate; the F11.1 spreadsheet itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single named comparable city was used. The basis is general Brazilian urban tourism pricing for Rio's main visitor districts (Copacabana, Ipanema, Leblon), translated into USD at recent exchange-rate levels. July is a lower-demand winter period outside peak summer and Carnival, though Brazilian school holidays add some domestic demand.
